purpose: Separate main-menu lighthouse, padded terrain, transparent props including a nearby pier.

prompts.lighthousePrompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Input is the ACTUAL MAIN MENU background of the existing game "Свет Авалона". Extract ONLY the exact existing LIGHTHOUSE TOWER as a separate transparent pixel-art SPRITE. The tower is the tall warm-window blue-grey stone lighthouse near x=390,y=240 of the 640x640 source, on the rocky headland. This is a faithful cutout, NOT a redesign and NOT a new lighthouse. Preserve its distinctive silhouette, domed cap and cross/finial, lantern glazing with warm amber light, balcony rail, individual masonry, narrow windows, small doorway and the compact stone stair/foot immediately touching its base. Preserve the original fine pixel clusters, colors, textures and proportions. No smoothing, painterly re-rendering or new ornaments. Do not use the shorter prototype tower from other images.
Remove the surrounding sky, sea, clouds, ruins/arch, broad rocky island and ground. Keep only the tower and the minimum small footing needed at its ground-contact point. No floating outer glow beyond sprite silhouette. Center the complete tower on a genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas with a small transparent margin; do not crop the finial or foot. No checkerboard baked in, no labels, no shadows on a backdrop, no other sprite. Sprite must be clearly recognizable as the EXACT tower from the supplied main page. Output RGBA transparency.
prompts.terrainPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable pixel-art coastal TERRAIN BACKGROUND with generous off-camera margin, for an existing high top-down lighthouse-defense game.
The supplied square map is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create ONE continuous LANDSCAPE terrain image, around 3:2 proportions at high resolution, showing a much more distant and much LARGER area of the SAME muted slate-blue Arthurian coast. Fine handcrafted pixel art; dark navy/teal water, quiet desaturated moss, old scattered broken paving and low rocks, sparse ruined masonry at the outer edges. High top-down camera with mild oblique depth, no horizon or sky.
CRITICAL: NO lighthouse, NO cannon, NO barrier, NO devices, NO pier, NO characters, NO monsters, NO HP bars, NO range circles, NO UI or lettering anywhere. Objects will be separate sprites over this ground.
Nearly straight vertical shoreline at the EXACT CENTER x=50%: land on LEFT, open water on RIGHT. The center of the image is an EMPTY low, level shoreline area for the future lighthouse base, not an island tip, no cliff precipice. A little irregular surf and shore stones are allowed but keep the implied physical land/water boundary straight; do not curve the coast into a peninsula. The center coastline point must be usable as a stable ground anchor.
GENERATE WITH LARGE SAFETY MARGINS: an open tactical play area occupies the middle HALF of the image; additional continuous plausible land and water extend at least one quarter image width beyond it to BOTH left/right and ample terrain above/below, so zooming out never reveals a blank border. The entire future spawn circumference and weapon ranges must fit within the texture with room remaining; no fake dark frame or artificial edge. Central tactical area relatively clear, dry land continuous, sea open, no huge decorative objects hiding units. Arch ruins can appear well toward far upper-left, never centered. Consistent pixel size, no blur or glossy 3D shading, subdued ambient dusk but usable visibility. No baked-in gameplay objects or overlays.
prompts.propsPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PIXEL SPRITE ATLAS for the existing dark Arthurian coastal defense game "Свет Авалона". Style reference is the supplied existing coastal game map; match its fine pixel art, aged bronze machinery, slate stone, amber highlights. High top-down with mild oblique depth.
Create ONE SQUARE RGBA atlas with four equal QUADRANTS in a clean 2x2 grid, no visible cell boundaries, truly transparent everywhere outside sprites. Exactly THREE separate objects, one per specified quadrant, no cross-cell overlap:
TOP LEFT: one compact bronze wheeled CANNON, muzzle unmistakably faces LEFT / west, breech and wheels on the right. Distinct readable silhouette, small ground foot only, no grass square or glow or baked shadow disk. Whole sprite fits in its cell, ample transparent margin.
TOP RIGHT: one low short slate stone BARRIER segment oriented approximately north-south in the tactical ground plane, slightly oblique perspective. No huge enclosing wall, no grass or ground tile, clear low silhouette.
BOTTOM LEFT: one modest nearby wooden PIER on aged stone shore footing, stretching from LEFT landward entrance to RIGHT seaward end. Weathered planks, four or six timber posts and two little mooring bollards, no boats, flags, buildings or enormous docks. Foot/root at left and deck extending right. It will be placed near the lighthouse later. Deck on transparent background, no water rectangle. Fits entirely within this cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT: EMPTY transparent quadrant, no object or mark.
Keep all three sprites separate, each centered in its cell and completely inside it. Render at a coherent fine pixel-art detail density; do not make huge 8-bit blocks or smooth vector curves. No letters, labels, numbers, grid lines, UI, scenes, background, monsters or lighthouse. Do not add a fourth object. Genuine alpha transparency, no checkerboard.
